description: This Java source file defines the 'BaseUnvoidHandler' class, which implements logic to un-void (reactivate) objects that implement the 'Voidable' interface within the OpenMRS API. The class primarily provides functionality to reset void-related fields for objects that are currently voided.

classes.name: BaseUnvoidHandler
classes.description: A class that handles the unvoiding process for objects implementing 'Voidable' by resetting void-related fields.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Unvoids a 'Voidable' object by resetting its void status, voider, void date, and void reason if it is currently voided and matches the original parent voided date conditions.
